title: Lattice–AMI WEF named representatives depth-3 pass
summary: Completed person-level and output-level expansion identifying Vincent Mattera, Grace Lee and John Neuffer, while selecting firmware technical governance as the final depth.

data.research_question: Which named representatives and concrete policy or publication outputs connect the Lattice-adjacent Coherent and SIA networks to WEF?
data.method: Official company, WEF initiative, community-roster, publication and semiconductor-policy source reconciliation.
classification_rules: Roster membership is recorded separately from authorship or decision authority.
Company succession is qualified when mapping II-VI records to Coherent.
WEF editorial coverage is not normalized into joint lobbying or coauthorship.
Failure to find a public delegate is recorded as unresolved, not as proof of absence.

findings.finding: Vincent D. Mattera Jr. was the named CEO sponsor of II-VI's 2021 WEF advanced-manufacturing partnership.
Grace Lee of Coherent is a current named member of WEF's Frontline Talent Excellence Community.
Coherent has an organization record in WEF's C-level operations and supply-chain officers community, but its delegate is not public.
The Frontline Talent initiative has concrete workforce publications and structured executive exchanges.
John Neuffer advocated for the Building Chips Act, and WEF later summarized the policy while citing industry rationale and criticism.
No named current Lattice WEF delegate or consumer-firmware ownership policy was found in reviewed public records.

provenance.method: Public-source recursive OSINT with bounded inference

workflow.next_action: Run firmware standards and governance depth-4 target.
